name: upy-maixpy-export-plugin
description: Standalone global-tool workflow for generating MaixPy code for Sipeed vision modules such as MaixCAM Pro.

interface.displayName: Sipeed 视觉模块代码生成
interface.shortDescription: Generate standalone MaixPy code for a Sipeed vision module.
interface.longDescription: Consumes a user vision task and emits sipeed_vision/main.py plus README guidance for running on Sipeed MaixCAM Pro with MaixPy/MaixVision. It does not flash firmware, does not use mpremote, and does not modify the MicroPython main workflow.
defaultPrompt: Generate MaixPy code for Sipeed MaixCAM Pro as a UART vision module.
Create sipeed_vision/main.py for object detection and send JSONL results over UART.
Create a MaixPy camera/display example for MaixVision.
